faqs.a: The Thursday rule: the week containing the first Thursday of the year is week 1. This correctly handles years where Jan 1 falls in the previous year's last week.
faqs.q: How is the ISO week computed?

faqs.a: Yes — about 71% of years have 52 weeks, the rest have 53. The tool returns the week-year too, which can differ from the calendar year near Jan 1.
